tasks.label: Firmware: Compile
tasks.command: arduino-cli compile --fqbn ${input:chip} --warnings all ${workspaceFolder}/firmware/ps2adapter && echo '✅ Compile OK' || { echo '❌ Compile FAILED'; exit 1; }
tasks.detail: Compile the PS/2-to-serial mouse adapter firmware for the selected chip.

tasks.label: Firmware: Upload
tasks.command: arduino-cli upload --fqbn ${input:chip} --port ${input:port} --verify --verbose ${workspaceFolder}/firmware/ps2adapter && echo '✅ Upload verified OK' || { echo '❌ Upload/verify FAILED'; exit 1; }
tasks.detail: Upload firmware to the board on the selected serial port and verify the flash.

tasks.label: Firmware: Compile & Upload
tasks.command: arduino-cli compile --fqbn ${input:chip} --upload --port ${input:port} --verify --verbose --warnings all ${workspaceFolder}/firmware/ps2adapter && echo '✅ Compile + Upload verified OK' || { echo '❌ Compile/Upload FAILED'; exit 1; }
tasks.detail: Compile and upload the firmware in one step, then verify the flash.

inputs.description: Serial port of the board (e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0 or /dev/ttyACM0):
